resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175))

def monitor():
    while True:
        if resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss > 1536*1024*1024:
            os._exit(97)

import working_gcd_notation as n
import pytest
def pins():
    return {str(p):{"bytes":len(p.read_bytes()),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(directory.glob("*.py"))}
before={"local":pins(),"prior":n.require_sources()}
class Capture:
    def __init__(self): self.ids=[]; self.reports=[]
    def pytest_collection_finish(self,session): self.ids=[i.nodeid for i in session.items]
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report):
        self.reports.append([report.nodeid,report.when,report.outcome,report.duration])
cap=Capture()
code=pytest.main(["-q",str(directory/"test_working_gcd_notation.py")],plugins=[cap])
after={"local":pins(),"prior":n.require_sources()}
assert before==after
assert not [x for x in sys.modules if x.startswith(("peano_lab.library.editions","check_alpha_"))]

raise SystemExit(code)'
